title: Caliph al-Mamun's raiders find the Great Pyramid empty

tellings.quote: um Arab raiders under Calif Mamun broke in to the Great Pyramid and they found it empty.

plain: When Arab raiders led by the Caliph al-Mamun broke into the Great Pyramid, they are said to have found it empty. A researcher named Graham Hancock tells Michels this, without naming a source, on an episode where he argues that the pyramid was a kind of gateway for consciousness. An empty pyramid matters to that argument because it suggests the building was not a tomb.
